propositions: BindingStore file has grown to 800 lines mixing persistence, load/save, tempfile cleanup, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, retired-state replacement, and alert persistence logic alongside identity policy.
Extract a private BindingRepository unit-of-work to own paths, original dictionaries, and persistence contracts while preserving byte-exact round trips and all existing exception semantics.
Preserve rotation-before-live order, retired-first move ordering, exact JSON serialization (sorted, indented, trailing newline), and best-effort alert writes without introducing multi-file atomicity.
Public BindingStore facade must remain unchanged in construction, loader, signatures, and shared inner dictionaries; callers see no behavior change.
Tickets publication must remain external to repository via reconcile_helpers.py five-file allowlisted seam with no local checkpoint publishing.
